verdicts.claim: 2022-23 cherry-blossom City Edition is pink on navy
verdicts.note: Checked live: the jersey has a bright-pink base, a blossom dotting the i and three blossoms over the jock tag. The Wizards announced its 2026-27 return. Fixed in the uniform dossier and reworded the hoops cue.

verdicts.claim: City Edition revival for 2026-27 (was a single report)

verdicts.claim: Gilbert Arenas is a cult hero and safe tie-in apart from 2010 gun incident
verdicts.note: Checked live: Arenas was charged in July 2025 with federal illegal-gambling counts over poker games at an Encino mansion. No outcome found. Added as a caveat to the hoops, fanbase and underground dossiers.

verdicts.claim: Goodman League plays at Barry Farm in summer, June-August
verdicts.note: Checked live: the 2025 season tipped off June 4 at the Barry Farm courts, with Events DC as presenting sponsor. The league was founded in 1977. No 2026-27 plans found.

verdicts.note: Spingarn High School is still open. Claim removed.

verdicts.note: Nothing supports the "first" claim. Reworded to a Jordan Brand NIL athlete.

verdicts.claim: Globe Poster archive is held at MICA
verdicts.note: The hoops dossier can't say who holds the archive, so the MICA claim is gone there. The music and art dossiers still say MICA acquired it in 2011. Confirm.

summary: The dossiers held up on established DC history: go-go, the Bullets rename, Goodman, Ben's, statehood and Emancipation Day. The cherry-blossom City Edition has a bright-pink base and is confirmed as returning. The old arena name became CareFirst Arena, and Oct 30 is a confirmed Cup Night, not the home opener. The brief's Oct 30 and mid-October timeline can't work from Oct 7, and its Aug 22 seeding date has passed.
